text.zh: Termius 把 cd 补全成了 rm -rf，好在被删的文件还被进程占着。只要进程不退出，就能用 lsof 找出标着 (deleted) 的文件和进程号，再到 /proc/<pid>/fd 里按文件描述符把它 cat 回来。文件多的时候，作者写了一个 Rust 小程序，从 lsof 的输出批量生成恢复脚本。这次救回了九成五以上的数据，但这招不保证全部找回，备份才是正道。
text.en: Termius autocompleted a cd into rm -rf, but the deleted files were still held open by a running process. As long as that process lives, lsof lists the files marked (deleted) with their process IDs, and each can be copied back out of /proc/<pid>/fd by its file descriptor. For whole folders the author wrote a small Rust program that turns lsof's output into a recovery script. Over 95% of the data came back, but nothing is guaranteed: keep backups.
